definitions.full: H5419. Nethan -melek [ תַּהְמֻּכָה ] noun feminine perversity, perverse thing (only Proverbs except Deut 32:20 ) — Plural absolute תַּהְמֻּכוֺת 32:20 8 t.; construct id. Prov 2:14 ; — perverse things , particularly utterances 2:12 ; 10:32 ; 23:33 , compare ת ׳מִּי 8:13 , ת ׳לְשׁוֺן 10:31 , and even ת ׳אִישׁ 16:28 (|| נִרְגָּן slanderer ); but also thoughts, devices 6:14 ; 16:30 ; ת ׳דּוֺר Deut 32:20 = perverse Generation , (|| בָּם לֹאאֵֿמֻן ), ׳ת רָ֑ע Prov 2:14 (|| רָ֑ע עֲשׂוֺת ). נְתַןמֶֿ֫לֶךְ proper name, masculine an official of Judah, Josiah's time 2Kin 23:11 ; ᵐ5 Ναθαν βασιλέως ( τοῦ εὐνούχου ), ᵐ5 L Ναθαν εὐνούχου τοῦ βασιλέως .
